snippet.title: 2026 Total Solar Eclipse (Official NASA Trailer)
snippet.description:
The Sun and Moon are coming together to put on a show for Earth, and we'll be sharing it with you.

On Aug. 12, 2026, a total solar eclipse will be visible in parts of Greenland, Iceland, northern Russia, the Atlantic Ocean, Spain, and a small corner of Portugal.

Viewers in other places in the Northern Hemisphere will also have the chance to experience a partial solar eclipse, including parts of the U.S. (from Alaska to North Carolina), most of Canada, much of Europe, and northwestern Africa.

We'll be broadcasting the eclipse live, so you can experience totality from anywhere.

Learn how to watch totality live with us: https://go.nasa.gov/4ftKdXd
Learn more about this solar spectacle: https://science.nasa.gov/eclipses/future-eclipses/total-solar-eclipse-on-august-12-2026/

Credit: NASA

snippet.title: "Aspen Summer Glow" Beautiful Relaxing Music, Peaceful Soothing Instrumental Music by Tim Janis
snippet.description:
"Aspen Summer Glow" Beautiful Relaxing Music, Peaceful Soothing Instrumental Music by Tim Janis. My instrumental music can help you find deep relaxation, relieve anxiety, and find peace. My music incorporates relaxing sounds of nature and features flute music, piano music, harp music, & violin music. I am a composer from The Rocky Mountains and I created my channel as a place to visit, relax and find peace.

Please leave a comment we would love to say hello to you :) Blessings and peace, Tim & Elizabeth, Reno, Roo Roo, Bella, Zunaira, Amna and Paige.

Discover the beauty of the Aspen groves through August. The peaceful calm of aspen leaves fluttering in the wind. Rest amongst the trees and watch the day go by feeling the warm summer sun, light breeze and birds hoping from branch to branch. Please enjoy these beautiful nature scenery while listening to my newest songs. We hope you enjoy our video and thanks so music for watching. Blessings and peace Tim & Elizabeth, Reno, Bella and Roo Roo
